name: Bean burgers and pita with broccoli
Chicken Cordon Bleu with creamed spinach
Lamb cheese gunge
method: cook pack of lamb mince with garlic, onions, carrots, and spinach. Add lea and perrins and cheese to taste

name: Scotch Broth
method: Add everything except kale to slow cooker and cook on high for 2-3 hours, then add kale and cook until tender (half an hour?) then keep on low until ready to eat. Longer you cook it, tastier it is.

name: Roasted carrot, garlic, and chickpea soup
Tandoori aloo with raita and pita
Roasted pepper soup
method: Roast pepper, tomato, onion, and garlic until burnt at ends. Boil potatoes in stock until soft. Add veg to stock and liquidise.

name: Potato and cheddar potage
method: Fry onion and garlic until onions are clear, add stock and potatoes & simmer until soft. Mash & add cheese

name: Celeriac stew
method: Boil celeriac & potato in stock. When soft, mash/blend some and add cheese & mustard to taste

name: Sweetcorn Chowder
method: Defrost sofrito, add potatoes & stock and cook until soft. add corn, and blend some to desired consistency.

name: Broccoli Soup
method: Fry onion and garlic. Add vegetables and stock. Cook until soft and mash/blend

name: Beetroot, bean, feta and quinoa salad
Beetroot, quinoa, and chili mint halloumi
Sweet dreams are made of greens
Thai tray bake
method: Roast veg for 30 mins then add coconut milk and paste

name: Pasta al Ceci
method: Fry chickpeas with sofritto, olives & a few capers, add dry pasta and toast, add water & stock cube & tomato paste. Parmesan to taste
